plan.brief:
- Port the Discord provider to Rust: implement the Discord REST v10 client (token auth, X-Super-Properties header, rate-limit buckets, retries), the Provider operations (whoami, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, search_messages, send_message, list_members, mark_read, snapshot), and the AuthProvider, in crates/providers/discord, with credentials under <config>/discord and a base-URL env override for tests. Reference: /tmp/agent-messenger-ref/src/platforms/discord.
- Port the Channel Talk provider to Rust: implement the desk-api client (cookie auth, rate-limit, retries), the Provider operations (whoami, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, search_messages, send_message, list_members, snapshot), and the AuthProvider, in crates/providers/channeltalk, with credentials under <config>/channeltalk and a base-URL env override for tests. Reference: /tmp/agent-messenger-ref/src/platforms/channeltalk.
- Wire and prove both providers end to end: expose them through the CLI, MCP server and HTTP server via the sdk, and prove behavior with a local mock HTTP server plus provider unit tests; keep cargo test --all-features, clippy -D warnings and fmt --check green.

goals.objective: Port the Discord provider to Rust: implement the Discord REST v10 client (token auth, X-Super-Properties header, rate-limit buckets, retries), the Provider operations (whoami, list_chats, get_chat, list_messages, search_messages, send_message, list_members, mark_read, snapshot), and the AuthProvider, in crates/providers/discord, with credentials under <config>/discord and a base-URL env override for tests. Reference: /tmp/agent-messenger-ref/src/platforms/discord.

successCriteria.scenario: Against a local mock Discord API (python http.server on 127.0.0.1) returning seeded GET /users/@me, /users/@me/guilds, /guilds/{id}/channels, /channels/{id}/messages, run target/debug/hyper-messenger chats discord and messages discord <channel> with HYPER_MESSENGER_DISCORD_API_BASE pointed at the mock and a stored token. PASS: exit 0 and the envelope data contains the seeded guild and channel names.
Mock Discord API returns HTTP 401 {"message":"401: Unauthorized","code":0} for /users/@me; run hyper-messenger chats discord. PASS: non-zero exit and envelope ok:false with error.code AUTH_FAILED.
Run cargo test --workspace --all-features after the Discord change and re-run the mock provider CLI read. PASS: every test binary reports ok and the mock provider still answers.

successCriteria.scenario: Against a local mock Channel Talk desk API returning GET /desk/account and GET /desk/channels, run hyper-messenger whoami channeltalk and chats channeltalk with HYPER_MESSENGER_CHANNELTALK_API_BASE pointed at the mock. PASS: exit 0 and data contains the seeded account and channel names.
Mock desk API returns HTTP 401 with a Channel error body; run hyper-messenger chats channeltalk. PASS: non-zero exit and envelope error.code AUTH_FAILED.
Run cargo test --workspace --all-features and re-run the Discord CLI read against its mock after the Channel Talk change. PASS: both green, so Channel Talk did not regress Discord or core.
